name: Scramble decode
visual_intent: A short technical word computes itself into place: accent glyphs cycle, then lock left to right and settle to the text colour.

performance_characteristics.dom_node_count: about (lead / step + slot) glyph spans per character
performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low; visibility switches only (estimate, not measured on the M2)

implementation_summary: Each character becomes a fixed slot with its final letter and prebuilt glyph spans picked by a seeded Studio.rng from the text; the timeline switches one glyph per step (2 frames) until the slot's lock time, then shows the letter in the accent and tweens it to the text colour. No callbacks, so any seek shows the same glyphs; aria-label keeps the word.
runtime_api: Studio.type.scramble(tl, el, at, {charset, lead, stagger, step, seed, settle})

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html (hidden before the cue, same glyphs on every seek, left-to-right lock, settles to the word and the text colour) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; frame review tests/reference-derived/scramble-strike-caption/qa/report.json (0 errors, 0 warnings). Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
